entities.name: APOBEC1
observations: Rat APOBEC1 increased EGFP reporter inactivation in AID-null DT40 cells and increased imatinib-resistant human CML clones through BCR-ABL1 mutations in a primary study.
Ectopic APOBEC1 caused low-level genomic DNA damage measured by γH2AX foci in a lung-cancer cell line; activity was constrained by RPA competition for ssDNA.
A separate mammalian assay found no APOBEC1-induced somatic hypermutation or class switching, indicating assay- and context-dependent activity.

entities.name: Esophageal adenocarcinoma
observations: A primary 2014 study reported an AID/APOBEC mutational pattern in EAC that mimicked APOBEC1 sequence preference in vitro.
EAC studies and reviews report APOBEC-associated COSMIC SBS2 and SBS13 in subsets of tumors, with cohort-dependent enrichment.

entities.name: COSMIC SBS2
observations: Predominantly C>T substitutions at cytosines in TC/TCN contexts; this is an APOBEC-associated signature but is not APOBEC1-specific.

entities.name: COSMIC SBS13
observations: Predominantly C>G and C>A substitutions at cytosines in TC/TCN contexts; this is an APOBEC-associated signature but is not APOBEC1-specific.

entities.name: APOBEC3A
observations: Modern enzyme-attribution evidence generally favors APOBEC3A as a source of canonical human APOBEC SBS2/SBS13 activity.

entities.name: APOBEC3B
observations: Modern enzyme-attribution evidence generally favors APOBEC3B as a source of canonical human APOBEC SBS2/SBS13 activity.

entities.name: PMID:25085003 APOBEC1 EAC
observations: Primary Genome Biology 2014 study reporting APOBEC1-induced mutagenesis in experimental systems and an APOBEC1-compatible mutation pattern in EAC.

entities.name: PMID:14559972 APOBEC1 negative assay
observations: Primary PNAS 2003 study reporting that APOBEC1 did not induce somatic hypermutation or class switching in tested mammalian cells.
